name: Need For Speed II SE
description:
Need for Speed II SE (Cross-Platform) is a modern open-source wrapper and port for the 1997 racing classic Need for Speed II: Special Edition. It restores 3D hardware acceleration and modern networking to the vintage racer.

Features:
- Hardware-accelerated 3D graphics utilizing modern OpenGL rendering backends
- Widescreen and high-resolution support with correct aspect ratio preservation
- Modern TCP/IP and UDP multiplayer support for LAN and online races
- Controller configuration supporting modern analog gamepads and racing wheels
- Requires original Need for Speed II: Special Edition game data files to play
